create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object and add nodes with start and accept flags
test_gtn_equal: test whether two gtn Graph objects are structurally equal using gtn.equal
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn Graph objects are isomorphic using gtn.isomorphic
load_save_graph_txt: load and save a gtn Graph to and from a text file using gtn.loadtxt and gtn.savetxt
load_save_graph_binary: load and save a gtn Graph to and from a binary file using gtn.load and gtn.save
